control: Test one joint axis and one released article configuration at a time.
evidence_required: configuration photo and serialized article record

control: Use the P0.7 joint geometry and exact received interfaces; do not substitute the full arm before single-axis closure.
Rigidly anchor the fixture to a surveyed bench with a separate secondary restraint or catch.
evidence_required: bench survey anchor calculation proof load and installed inspection

control: The outer guard may contain debris but shall not carry intended fixture reaction loads.
evidence_required: independent load path drawing and inspection

control: Measure every inertial surrogate mass COM and attachment before use.
evidence_required: traceable scale and balance record plus attachment inspection

control: Select force sensor overload capacity stiffness mounting and orientation from a bounded load case.
Keep all people outside the containment envelope and operate remotely with the E-stop reachable outside the hazard.
evidence_required: approved layout work control and witnessed dry run

control: Use physical source current and voltage limiting independent of motion software.
evidence_required: exact source protection settings and measured open-circuit behavior

control: Inspect fasteners witness marks cables stop bumper and sensor preload before and after every increment.
Abort on unexpected motion noise heat smoke data loss fixture shift sensor saturation or guard contact.
evidence_required: written abort criteria and recorded run disposition

control: Do not infer safe limits from a catalog stall/no-load endpoint or a single successful run.
evidence_required: qualified test plan with repetition and uncertainty treatment

control: No powered stage may execute until its existing E2 E3 or E4 gate and written authorization are satisfied.
